Democracy ⓘ >>EIU Democracy Index, 2024

The index is based on five categories: electoral process and pluralism, functioning of government, political participation, political culture, and civil liberties. Based on its 0-10 scores on a range of indicators within these categories, each country is classified as one of four types of regime: “full democracy”, “flawed democracy”, “hybrid regime” or “authoritarian regime."
